questions.question: Where does Piotr go at the beginning of the story?
answers: To the Central Archives of Modern Records
questions.explanation: He stands in front of the building of the Central Archives of Modern Records.

questions.question: What did he get from the unknown man in Łomża?
answers: An envelope with copies of documents from 1945
questions.explanation: The envelope contained copies of documents with testimonies.

questions.question: What does the archive director say about the truth in this matter?
answers: That the truth is like the Holy Grail — everyone searches, nobody wants to find
That it is in the textbook
questions.explanation: He says the truth is inconvenient for all sides.

questions.question: Who is Marek, the man who meets Piotr in the café?
questions.explanation: Marek is a history teacher at the local high school.

questions.question: What does Piotr write at the end of his article about history?
answers: That it belongs to one side
That history is a search for truth, and Jedwabne is more complex than we were told
questions.explanation: He writes about the complexity of the truth and about history not belonging to any one side.
